title: AnalyticalTable
description: Virtualized Fiori analytical grid with WCR column sizing, reordering, visibility, freezing, sorting, filtering, grouping, aggregation, tree rows, row selection, row details, infinite scroll, responsive pop-in, and F2 editing.

usage.summary: Compare wide or large datasets in a virtualized Fiori grid with configurable column widths, order, visibility and freezing.
useWhen: Keep identifying columns visible while users scroll horizontally through measures.
Let users resize, reorder and hide columns with controlled layout state.
Load additional rows on scroll and move secondary columns into the row at narrower widths.
Use the experimental Customise API for protected cell content, header menu actions and layout replacements.

avoidWhen.when: Render a lighter data-driven table with sorting and responsive pop-in.
Compose static rows and cells directly in JSX.
